source_pending_meaning: Fixed assessment source, artifact assistance, ordinary-UI opportunities, and equivalent prepared fixtures are not established by this plan.

relational_substitution.reason: No actual UI relationship evidence establishes the required four-case relational opportunity. Retain the two multiple-step requests.

fixture_variants.base: PROPOSED: two distinct ordinary visible seed records per application.
fixture_variants.b_changed: PROPOSED: B changed through ordinary UI while A remains unchanged; used for R2, U2, and CH4.

learner_input_boundary: Only the ordinary goal and arguments for the selected request, plus equally authorized access and automatically learned assistance, enter the two arms. Fixture expectations, scheduling controls, and expected_results.json remain evaluator/coordinator material. Do not provide selectors, action recipes, operation schemas, or expected answers.
unsupported_policy: Preserve every goal and argument, including search/filter semantics, unread choices, duplicate qualifiers, tag chains, and absent-result scope. Unsupported, unavailable, refused, or unestablished cases remain in the fixed denominator.

budgets.scope: Per application and arm, including failed attempts; fixture setup is cumulative, not renewed silently for each case.

independent_verification.writes_restricted_to: Search/filter actions only; no saved business changes.

interruption_recovery.prerequisite: Justified independent read-back before any retry.

budgets.accounting: Count every attempted primitive, navigation, reload, failed authentication, possible write, snapshot read, and polling time. Retain CPU, peak RSS, model/token use, retries, browser restarts, resets, manual assistance, and application-specific code separately. Shared acquisition is charged to both arms with physical cost recorded once; recipe preparation is separate.

proposed_schedule.arm_order: Odd case numbers: SemABI then cached-form; even case numbers: cached-form then SemABI. Run arms sequentially.
proposed_schedule.reset_preconditions: Root first coordinates idle evaluated and checker sessions and preserves all preceding evidence. Treat reset storage as opaque; do not inspect installation data, databases, or private state.
proposed_schedule.existing_wrapper_capability: The existing reset command restores its existing initial-account baseline. It has no command to capture the proposed prepared fixtures.
proposed_schedule.pairing_requirement: Each paired arm must start from equivalent independently confirmed ordinary visible fixtures. Record actual reset identity/cost and ordinary-UI fixture evidence. Otherwise label the pair unmatched and retain every request.
proposed_schedule.setup_budget_constraint: Equivalent prepared-fixture restoration is pending. Rebuilding two seeds through UI before every arm must not be assumed to fit the cumulative setup budget. An initial-account reset is not evidence that these proposed records exist.
proposed_schedule.fixture_sequence: Prepare two base records through ordinary UI. For R2, U2, and CH4, change B through ordinary UI to the b_changed variant while preserving A; for CH4, make this change after acquisition of the saved base meaning. Every other case starts from base.
proposed_schedule.restart_case: Before C2, coordinate a service restart and a fresh evaluated browser for each arm. The baseline retains the same shared artifact; retain restart evidence.
proposed_schedule.viewport_case: Use 1280 by 900 as the proposed standard viewport and 800 by 900 for CH3. Record the actual rendered difference before making a presentation claim.
proposed_schedule.session_cases: CH5 requires actual logout in the evaluated session. CH6 requires an available intervention point in the evaluated owned browser and independent read-back before any retry. Unavailable opportunities remain explicit.
proposed_schedule.freeze_requirement: Freeze the concrete requests, source, dependencies, policy, baseline, and settings before onboarding. No task replacement based on performance; a general code repair ends a fixed-source assessment.
